text: Remote workers must submit time logs by Friday 5 PM.
On-site employees are required to log entry via physical badge readers.
Contractors must submit invoices monthly by the 25th.
Full-time remote staff receive a $500 home office stipend.
Hourly remote workers must take a mandatory 30-minute break after 5 hours.
New rule: remote workers must submit weekly reports by Monday noon.
Employees requesting leave must notify their manager at least two weeks in advance.
Engineering teams must submit production incident reports within 24 hours.
